notes.title: Demo Update v1.0.4
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

The demo version of Shining Hero has been updated to v1.0.4.

[ul]
[] This update includes recent changes since the New Release Festival.
[] A new boss, an elite enemy, and a normal enemy have been added to the first stage.
[] The game's initial difficulty has been lowered. Players can now choose progression difficulties, with four progression levels available in the demo. Each progression level unlocks the next upon completion.
[] The Mage character is temporarily unavailable in the demo.
[/ul]

As the game is still in development, you may encounter errors or translation mistakes while playing the demo. We appreciate your understanding.

You can use the link below to contact us and report bugs.

Thank you for your support and understanding! We look forward to your valuable feedback to help us create a better gaming experience together!

Enjoy the game!

Orange Cat Studio
